description: Jochen Schubert and colleagues publish analysis scripts accompanying the Los Angeles 100-year flood-risk study. Seven freely downloadable MATLAB and Stata files under MIT cover exposure calculations, municipal hazard and disadvantage measures, and Lorenz-style inequality analyses. The study combines rainfall, river and storm-tide hazards with property and socioeconomic exposure. These scripts can compare distributional outcomes from urban flood simulations. Although the Zenodo description also discusses a dataset, its visible inventory contains code; the linked data deposit has DOI 10.7280/D1RH7Z and is a separate dependency. The code’s input schema, software versions and exact study-year coverage remain uncertain from the public summary. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Neither scripts nor input data were downloaded, and the paper’s reported exposure totals were not independently reproduced.
